blockers.detail: With network_mode = no-network, Harbor 0.20.0's docker environment runs main and ledger in the egress-control sidecar's network namespace, so the source address ledger:8080 does not resolve (URLError: Name or service not known) and no trial can be graded. A control-only copy with network_mode = public graded recorded = 1, which isolates the cause to egress control.
blockers.recommendation: Leave unpublished. Do not change the source address to localhost or loosen network_mode. Ask the integration owner to confirm Compose service-name resolution under the platform's no-network policy (NEO-2085) and rerun the smoke test there.
